answer_1.quote: We also adopt LongBench to further evaluate the long-context generation performance of our method and the baselines. We choose eight subsets from four different task types in LongBench as our practical datasets. They are single document QA task (Qasper), summarization task (QMSum, MultiNews), few-shot learning task (TREC, TriviQA, SAMSum), and code completion task (LCC, RepoBench-P).
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include answers to questions, summaries of documents, responses in few-shot learning settings, and code completions.

answer_2.quote: F1 score is used as the evaluation metric for Qasper and Trivi-aQA, while ROUGE score is used for QMSum, and MultiNews, and similarity score is used for LCC and RepoBench-P. Only TREC uses classification score as the evaluation metric.
